observations.body: Mark 1:8–13 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit is locally described; the wording centers attention on “He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit. Immediately coming up from the water.”

payload.posture: Read Mark 1:8–13 as evidence about the Spirit, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states mark 1:8–13 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit is locally described; the wording centers attention on “He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit. Immediately coming up from the water.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
